checks.recommendation: WAPE rather than MAPE as the forecast metric, so a handful of extremes cannot dominate the error
freight enters as a line cost, never as a model target
COALESCE(..., 'unknown') rather than dropping the rows
no FK declared on that column -- an FK there would reject the load; the gap is handled in the silver layer
surrogate review_key primary key, so duplicates are preserved rather than rejected
review text lives in MongoDB, not in a relational column of mostly nulls
same -- optional fields belong in a document store
lead times computed only from delivered orders; the rest are excluded explicitly rather than silently producing null intervals

scoring: Score = 100 minus the weighted share of rows that breached a check. INFO rows are reported but excluded by default: they record expected structure, not defects.
